PURPOSE: | This unit standard is for persons who are responsible to apply basic first aid in a workplace. Persons credited with this unit standard are able to:
 Assess the emergency situation.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
The request received identifies the users and their terms of support so that the response procedure can be determined. , The request received records sufficient information about the problem to begin an investigation., The contact with users of the request received employs personal communication techniques which allows users to feel that the problem will be resolved to their satisfaction. , The request received is assigned a timeframe and priority to the problem according to organisation standards and the terms of the support agreement for each user.
Activities | Complete the following questions as per instructions provided
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
1 | What are the parameters of a problem?
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
2 | Once you have collected information about a problem, what is the next step in the process of solving the problem?
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
3 | Define the process of Determining a course of action
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
4 | Define any three common computer problems

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
The investigation uses information sources to identify known problems., The investigation use industry recommended procedures to identify the cause of the problem. , The investigation records symptoms of unresolved identified problems to be forwarded to technical support services to resolve., The investigation advises users of progress according to the terms of their support agreement., The investigation advises third parties of progress according to the terms of the user's support agreement.
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
6 | Define the following user support problems : Hardware failure; Software issue and User-created problem.

sections.heading: SESSION 3.
sections.text: Implement solutions to computer user's problems.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
The implementation ensures that the user's system is returned as soon as possible., The implementation uses reference data sources to identify known solutions to known problems. , The implementation designs solutions for any new problems identified., The implementation records the action taken in sufficient detail to allow it to be repeated., The implementation monitors progress of a solution so that users may be advised of progress according to the terms of their support agreement.
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
7 | Explain how to review a solution
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
8 | Why is it important to consult stakeholders?
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
9 | Why is it useful to standardise a solution?

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
The closure presents a report on the resolution of each problem to the user, so that they may judge that the problem has been satisfactorily resolved., The closure records resolution of the problem according to organisation standards and procedures.
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
10 | Outline the general factors that are contained in a record
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
11 | List the techniques of solving problems

sections.heading: SESSION 5.
sections.text: Forward unresolved computer user's problems to appropriate area.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
The extension of the problem is reported to the user involved, according to the terms of their support agreement. , The extension advises third parties of progress according to the terms of the user's support agreement., The extension records additional information on unresolved identified problems to be forwarded to appropriate area to resolve.
Activity | Questions Description | Mark
12 | Discuss unresolved computer problems and support agreements

PURPOSE: | This unit standard is for persons who are responsible to apply basic first aid in a workplace. Persons credited with this unit standard are able to:
 Assess the emergency situation.
 Identify the physical condition of casualties.
 First aid treatment of casualties.
LEARNING ASSUMED TO BE IN PLACE:
The ability to read and write at ABET Level 2 or equivalent will facilitate better understanding and proficiency in this unit standard.

SESSION 1.
Receive computer user's problems.

Learning Outcomes
The request received identifies the users and their terms of support so that the response procedure can be determined. , The request received records sufficient information about the problem to begin an investigation., The contact with users of the request received employs personal communication techniques which allows users to feel that the problem will be resolved to their satisfaction. , The request received is assigned a timeframe and priority to the problem according to organisation standards and the terms of the support agreement for each user.

SESSION 2.
Investigate computer user's problems.

Learning Outcomes
The investigation uses information sources to identify known problems., The investigation use industry recommended procedures to identify the cause of the problem. , The investigation records symptoms of unresolved identified problems to be forwarded to technical support services to resolve., The investigation advises users of progress according to the terms of their support agreement., The investigation advises third parties of progress according to the terms of the user's support agreement.

SESSION 3.
Implement solutions to computer user's problems.

Learning Outcomes
The implementation ensures that the user's system is returned as soon as possible., The implementation uses reference data sources to identify known solutions to known problems. , The implementation designs solutions for any new problems identified., The implementation records the action taken in sufficient detail to allow it to be repeated., The implementation monitors progress of a solution so that users may be advised of progress according to the terms of their support agreement.

SESSION 4.
Close resolved computer user's problems.

Learning Outcomes
The closure presents a report on the resolution of each problem to the user, so that they may judge that the problem has been satisfactorily resolved., The closure records resolution of the problem according to organisation standards and procedures.

SESSION 5.
Forward unresolved computer user's problems to appropriate area.

Learning Outcomes
The extension of the problem is reported to the user involved, according to the terms of their support agreement. , The extension advises third parties of progress according to the terms of the user's support agreement., The extension records additional information on unresolved identified problems to be forwarded to appropriate area to resolve.
